about: A Python library for showing dates, numbers and text in the right format for each language.

prs.title: Two-digit years no longer land a century in the future
prs.broken: Reading a short date like 3/9/99 gave the year 2099, so old dates such as birth dates moved a century ahead and a formatted date did not read back as itself.
prs.changed: Two-digit years now fall within 80 years before and 20 years after today, the same window ICU and Java use.
prs.matters: Apps that read short dates get the year people meant.
